title: Jeff Quest
description:
- Plot -

In Jeff Quest, you'll follow the story of Jeff, who—due to a failed experiment—has shrunk to the size of an insect. His relationship with Mia is in crisis, and you'll have to try to find her so he can apologize. But many dangers await you, including death scenes if you take the wrong path, and so on—and toward the end, you’ll discover that Mia will love both of you.

- Details -

• Jeff Quest features death scenes to make his adventure realistic—and even dangerous—as he sets out on his journey to find Mia.

• The game does not currently include soundtracks, but we will be working on them in future updates.

• The game doesn't have any RPG elements, but it's a story-driven game with dialogue and even some short cutscenes to make the whole experience as realistic as possible.

• The goal of the game is to apologize to Mia, but there are dangers along the way.

• Multiple endings: The game features a bad ending and the canonical happy ending.
